title: The UK FCA says it plans to require DeFi platforms to obtain authorization, adopting a stricter stance than the US and the EU after the $6.3B Binance hack (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: The UK FCA says it plans to require DeFi platforms to obtain authorization, adopting a stricter stance than the US and the EU after the $6.3B Binance hack — FCA points to Binance heist and ‘lack of consumer protections’ as reasons for tighter regulation of decentralised finance than in US and EU
